comment: The mod builds this release offers. scripts/make_patches.py turns each into patcher/patches/sidecar-<tag>.json. The first build is the default. A build with "unreleased" is hidden on the page, and scripts/check_unreleased.py stops the site's deploy while one is listed: delete the key only on release day. A build's "stock_name" and "built" name its stock file and our .syx in the build folder, when not the OS 1.73 defaults. "{{SHA256 ...}}" slots are filled from the release build; the deploy stops while one is left.

builds.title: rel0-4-0: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.73 (default, recommended)
builds.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.4.0 on OS 1.73: everything in rel0-3-1, plus the pan and route report master FX's through mode needs, MD's own page, the JUNO / 6-OP FM preset browser and DSP SAMPLE's sample picker on knob A of SRC, list knobs of up to 36 names, the MIDI machine (machine 50) and the arpeggiator's page (UP + FLTR); the Sidecar's SRC view comes back after a BANK tap, and a drawing race that could make the animated SRC pages flicker is fixed. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0.elemod with version 1.73 (sha256 {{SHA256 Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.73_rel0-4-0.syx, first 8 ... last 5}}). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.

unreleased.why: Sidecar 0.4.0 is not released yet: the patch file comes from the release build.

builds.title: rel0-4-0-os1.74: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.74 (in testing)
builds.description: The same mods as rel0-4-0, built for OS 1.74, the OS Elektron offers now: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx. In testing: run in the emulator only, not yet on a unit. Moving a Rytm from 1.73 to 1.74 is one way: back up every project first; recovery is the stock 1.74 file. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 {{SHA256 Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74_rel0-4-0.syx, first 8 ... last 5}}). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.

unreleased.why: Sidecar 0.4.0 is not released yet: the patch file comes from the release build.

builds.title: rel0-3-1: Sidecar 0.3.1 mods (older)
builds.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.1: everything in rel0-3-0, plus the fix that makes send FX follow a kit switch at once. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.1.elemod (sha256 a203db27...3df3c). Goes with Sidecar 0.3.1 on the Pi.

builds.title: rel0-3-0: Sidecar 0.3.0 mods (older)
builds.description: The mods for Sidecar 0.3.0: everything in rui1027d, plus projects keyed by the Rytm's slots (SAVE AS / copy / clear follow, the project trash), kits following SAVE / RELOAD KIT, NO + KIT / PATTERN reload on the Sidecar's pages, the poly sequencer's pages and keys (FUNC + YES undo, FUNC + DOWN menu), the SIDECAR MENU with WEB UI (the pairing code), and a freeze probe that reports a stuck Rytm screen to the Sidecar. The same file elekloader builds from core 0.1 + rytm-sidecar-0.3.0.elemod (sha256 893ed9a5...733ab). Needs Sidecar 0.3.0 on the Pi.

builds.title: rui1027d: Sidecar 0.1.0 / 0.2 mods + remote pages (older)
builds.description: Everything in sfx1021, plus the remote pages: a connect screen when the Sidecar comes up, and with TRK + YES the SIDECAR and SYSTEM status pages, SCOPE and meters, the LFO page (TRK + LFO), the REC page with playback and channel picking on the trig keys (Sidecar on the Pi) and the voice pages, in the Rytm's own font, on Sidecar Mini and Sidecar; the SRC view (the Sidecar machine's page on the Rytm's own SRC page); the Rytm's FX return on IN L/R for recording and SCOPE. The page catches only the keys and knobs it uses: PLAY / STOP / RECORD always reach the Rytm, pads, mutes, FILL and tap tempo work as usual.

builds.title: sfx1021: Sidecar mods without the remote pages
builds.description: External voice machines (PLAITS, DAISYSP, JUNO, FM, DIGIDRUM, DSP SAMPLE and user machines) on every track, the SEND FX 1/2 pages (AMPLITUDE 2; TYPE and P1..P5 with the Sidecar's FX labels, stepped lists), and the SIDECAR folder in the sample browser. The same mods as rui1027d without the remote pages.

builds.title: a4-sa12: Analog Four MKII, OS 1.56
builds.description: The A4 mod 0.12 for Sidecar 0.4.0. A track's sound can pick a Sidecar machine, whose audio comes back through that voice's analog filters, overdrive and amp; chords on any track, locks and LFOs on the machine's knobs, the Sidecar's pages on the A4's screen with UP + YES; with a Sidecar, UP and DOWN leave the keyboard's octave alone. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.3.elemod + sidecar-a4-0.12.elemod with the lock file a4156.lock.json and version SA12 (sha256 {{SHA256 Analog-Four_MKII_OS1.56_a4-sa12.syx, first 8 ... last 6}}). Needs Sidecar 0.4.0.

unreleased.why: A4 support reaches people with Sidecar 0.4.0: the patch file comes from the release build, after SA12 has run on a real A4.
